project: Muhlnickel weightless one-file speaking Titan; not Kaggriculture Titan or Kaggle/ARC

callable_signatures: png(path, w, h, data, gray=False, depth=8)
tools.read_write_roles: Reads source files; never changes source. Writes PNG for rendering/visual modes and text manifest for manifest mode. Other modes print to stdout. manifest and watch --full are whole-file streaming paths; static summaries generally read the requested source window into memory.
tools.large_file_support: --offset/--len bounds in-memory modes. manifest streams the entire file in default 4 MiB chunks and emits one hash/nonzero count per chunk. watch --full streams full passes in default 1 MiB chunks and is bounded-memory. map streams full file by chunks. strip is stratified sampling: up to 4096 columns with at most 65536 bytes read per column, not 100% coverage. watch without --full samples windows; with one probe and no --len it can retain whole snapshots in memory. dag/levels/step load the selected window and materialize records/graph; set --len on large inputs.
tools.artifact_outputs: PNG, .mf manifest, or console metrics/listings depending on mode.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.cli: python muhl_live.py CONTAINER [offset count | rec index [n] | scan | watch secs]
tools.read_write_roles: Read-only byte/stat/record output. No artifact output.
tools.large_file_support: Byte window capped at 1 MiB; record dump capped at 64 records; scan refuses files over 8 MiB and refuses titan.gguf/dc.mno. watch is a stub: stats only, no repeated reads or change detection.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: wire/address construction and graph reporting library
tools.read_write_roles: In-memory gate-list/address construction and metrics only. No container reads/writes or file outputs.
tools.large_file_support: No file I/O; memory use scales with the constructed gate list and maps.
tools.artifact_outputs: Python objects and report dictionary; no persisted artifact.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.read_write_roles: Appends gate tuples to Python lists; no container I/O, no output files.
tools.large_file_support: No file I/O; construction scales in host memory with vector width/shape.
tools.artifact_outputs: Mutated gate list and returned wire/address index; no persisted artifact.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: physical-record fabricator plus one-byte host input/output helpers
tools.read_write_roles: fabricate writes a raw record stream to the named output file; inject opens container r+b and writes byte 0x01 at one receiver address; surface opens rb and reads one byte per requested address.
tools.large_file_support: No container-sized scan. fabricate materializes the full output blob in memory. inject/surface use bounded seek/read/write per supplied address.
tools.artifact_outputs: Raw gate-record file plus in-memory report from fabricate; inject returns receiver/container metadata; surface returns address-to-bytes map.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: harness/transcript policy gates (not a compute instrument)
tools.cli: python muhl_checkers.py status | binary|selfaudit|debunk|read|tick|stale|fable < JSON payload on stdin
tools.read_write_roles: Reads JSON on stdin and selected transcript/bit-dump metadata as needed; writes diagnostics to stderr and returns exit 0 or 2. It does not read/evaluate gate tables as the answer computation. No artifact output.
tools.large_file_support: Scans transcript JSONL wholly into Python lists; stale dump inspection reads dump text into memory. Not a large-container scanner.
tools.artifact_outputs: stderr gate explanation or status text on stdout; no project artifact.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: one-time scan-circuit builder with host reference verification
tools.read_write_roles: Reads the proof seed generator/source and historical registry/container; default main writes bitwise key table and circuit records into hardcoded titan.gguf, appends genome journal, updates registry; --dry avoids those writes; --revert restores journaled content. It runs host ripple verification before store.
tools.large_file_support: Direct container selection uses absolute addresses; builder and reference verifier materialize gate/input state in host memory. Fixed 128-row table, not generic arbitrarily large search.
tools.artifact_outputs: MUHLKEYB and MUHLSCN1 blobs in container, genome journal, registry entry listing probe/hit/index/match addresses.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: host evaluator for stored scanner, fabrication-time only
tools.read_write_roles: Opens titan.gguf read-only via mmap and registry; reconstructs stored gate records and bitwise table; Python ripple loop computes gates over probe cases; writes console report only.
tools.large_file_support: Maps whole titan.gguf read-only; allocates reconstructed netlist and state arrays in host memory. Not a runtime reader.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: proof-table builder with host-side row scan/equality evaluation
callable_signatures: probe_container(tab, key, c, outs, field, stats)
tools.read_write_roles: Builds K/S axiom seed tables in Python; default main writes MUHLPKN1 and MUHLPIM1 tables into titan.gguf, appends genome journal and registry. probe_container reads mmap bytes, Python-unpacks rows, constructs bit columns, and calls SS.ripple_sliced; main also loops every implication row.
tools.large_file_support: Container mmap, but table rows are iterated in host code in LANES windows and converted to Python integer bit-slices. This is not a file-native query loop.
tools.artifact_outputs: Tables within titan.gguf, genome journal, registry metadata and host console report.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: direct state-byte board reader plus static circuit structure check
tools.read_write_roles: Reads registry and mmap of titan.gguf; decodes 16x16 board by reading eight state bit-bytes per cell; separately scans 25-byte gate records for structure and addresses. No writes.
tools.large_file_support: Maps entire titan.gguf; reads the declared gate span and 256*8 state bytes.
tools.artifact_outputs: Console: structural metadata, board bytes decoded to hex, no correctness verdict.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: host readback and emulator verification of stored proof software
tools.read_write_roles: Read-only mmap reads program, proof regions and CPU circuit; then constructs Python memory images, calls independent reference, and executes reference transitions/host ripple on a bounded prefix.
tools.large_file_support: Whole-container mmap; bounded gate prefix verification (300 instructions in this file), but proof/program/region decoding happens in host memory.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately

tools.category: one-time autofab gate-stream builder with internal rail and genome self-edit design
tools.read_write_roles: build constructs Python tuples of gate records and a layout map; main performs source-level mutant-list comparisons and reports topology/depth, then without --write is dry. With --write, it writes a raw <BQQQ> record file to sibling AUTOFAB0.mno. It does not load or run an existing artifact, read an external prompt, or implement runtime input/fire/surface.
tools.large_file_support: Emits a full gate list/blob in host memory and may create an output file; not a large-file reader or streaming runtime.
tools.artifact_outputs: On --write, raw AUTOFAB0.mno gate records in sibling directory. Otherwise console text only.
tools.source_read: complete static source read; current execution is recorded separately
